result.summary: Found 1 significant content issue: a delivery fee is rendering as an invalid numeric value.

issues.description: The “Smash Bros Burgers” card displays “€NaN delivery,” exposing a calculation or missing-data error to users.
issues.suggestion: Validate and format the delivery fee before rendering. If the value is unavailable, show a safe fallback such as “Delivery fee unavailable” or omit the fee.
